description:
THE COUNTERWEIGHT. 018A lowers scores by design, so without a fixture that must stay high the set is a one-way ratchet into pessimism and an over-correction passes clean.

Constructed, and openly so: every requirement here is something resume.md demonstrates in an ## EXPERIENCE or ## PROJECTS bullet rather than lists in ## SKILLS, it asks 3+ years rather than 5-8, and it states no degree requirement. That is the point -- it isolates the single question 'does the ranker still reward genuine evidence?' from every credential and tenure gap the other fixtures probe.

The band is measured, not assumed: this exact JD scored 98 under 018A ('Near-perfect match on LLM evaluations, prompts, TypeScript/React, Supabase, and Riyadh location'). The first ceiling fixture was a real posting archived at 95, which measurement showed was itself inflation -- see inflation-genai-credentialed.
source: constructed to match resume.md's demonstrated evidence; band probed live 2026-09-07

job.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

We are hiring a Senior AI Product Engineer in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to own LLM-powered product features end to end.

Key Responsibilities
- Ship production LLM application features from prototype to live traffic
- Design and maintain prompt frameworks and agentic workflows
- Build evaluation pipelines that judge-score prompt, model and temperature variants
- Enforce output contracts and guardrails so model output is validated before it reaches users
- Build and operate the serverless backend and data layer behind those features
- Instrument production monitoring and alerting for AI features
- Work directly with founders and users; own features rather than tickets

Qualifications
- 3+ years building and shipping production software
- Strong Python and TypeScript
- Hands-on experience building LLM applications against hosted model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenRouter)
- Practical prompt engineering and LLM evaluation experience
- Experience with output validation and guardrails for model responses
- React and a modern serverless stack (Netlify, Vercel or similar)
- PostgreSQL and role-based access control
- CI/CD, monitoring and error tracking (GitHub Actions, Sentry or similar)
- Comfortable owning a system solo, from schema to deployment
- Based in Saudi Arabia. Arabic and English.
- A degree is not required; shipped production work matters more.

Nice to Have
- Experience with Arabic-language product edge cases
- Payment gateway integration experience
